voice.welcome: Welcome to the Button-Zipper Lab. Pick a fastener to practice.
voice.zipper-start: Hold the jacket steady, then pull the zipper up.
voice.zipper-nudge: Slow and steady. Follow the glowing track upward.
voice.zipper-help: My helper paw can hold the jacket with you.
voice.button-start: Guide the button across and through its buttonhole.
voice.button-nudge: Follow the curved stitches toward the buttonhole.
voice.snap-start: Slide the flap onto the shiny snap.
voice.snap-press: Now press and hold until it clicks.
voice.snap-nudge: Bring the two shiny snap parts together.
voice.velcro-start: Peel the orange tab away from the fuzzy strip.
voice.velcro-nudge: Keep peeling along the glowing stitches.
voice.round-one: One fastener finished. Beautiful patient hands!
voice.round-two: Two fasteners finished. You are getting smoother!
voice.round-three: Three fasteners finished. You did the whole set!
voice.mode-complete: You earned a brand-new fastener patch!
voice.all-complete: Every patch is yours. You are a getting-dressed champion!
voice.idle: Touch the glowing fastener and follow the stitched path.
voice.again: Ready to practice that fastener again.
